summary.intent: Execute Phase 65 of the CipherBox GSD workflow (SDK write-chain, bin re-link, and invite-claim) across 7 plans in 4 waves using parallel worktree subagents, then ship the phase via PR with full review hardening.
summary.outcome: All 7 plans implemented and verified (4/4 must-haves), security audit passed (29/29 threats), PR #583 opened with all CI green, 20+2 CodeRabbit/greptile review threads resolved across two fix rounds, and a real runtime-breaking serialization bug in bin nodeReadKey encoding caught and fixed post-PR.

repo: Write plane is keyed by node UUID (childId), read plane is keyed by IPNS name — shared-write ops touching both planes must thread both identifiers separately or risk silent mismatches (deleteFromSharedFolder had this bug).

encryptBinMetadata did a plain JSON.stringify of BinEntry, turning Uint8Array nodeReadKey into {"0":..} on the wire — every restoreFromBin would have thrown at sealChildReadKey at runtime; bin.test.ts mocks both helpers so this was invisible until greptile caught it.
The type doc at packages/core/src/bin/types.ts:69-70 explicitly promised hex wire encoding for nodeReadKey but the implementation didn't do it — a documented contract that was never enforced.

rotateWriteFromNode originally fired per-node tombstones inline; child tombstones could fire before the parent was re-pointed. Fixed by collecting pendingTombstones and firing only after the full subtree publishes.

SharedWriteContext reshape in 65-04 (shared-write.ts) was under-scoped: consumers context.ts and client.ts were not in files_modified, breaking the full pnpm typecheck post-merge. The post-merge gate caught it; the worktree's targeted vitest+build did not.

65-04 also cascaded into apps/web (shared-folder-projection.ts) requiring a Phase-68-marked optional bridge with PLACEHOLDER_PUBLISHED_NODE sentinel to maintain typecheck green without wiring real values.

The pre-existing sdk-e2e suites (batch-upload, ipns-consistency, file-operations) have broken TypeScript types from an earlier metadata refactor (FolderChild, FilePointer, SealedChildRef.id/.type removed) — they fail tsc but vitest --filter only loads matching files so the new suite runs unaffected.
grant-remint.test.ts fails in worktrees because @cipherbox/api-client is not built in the isolated worktree environment — a pre-existing infrastructure limitation, not a test failure.
gh pr edit fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL; PR body updates must go through gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file.

The chore(release) release-bot commit does not always appear on the branch — Release Preview can pass without emitting a version bump commit if no versioned packages changed in a way that triggers it.

code.finding: fromBinWireForm (decrypt path) decoded nodeReadKey hex without enforcing 32-byte length — wrong-length hex would yield a Uint8Array that reached key-sealing unchecked; fixed with explicit length guard.
Wire encoding contract for nodeReadKey (hex string) was documented here but not implemented in encryptBinMetadata/decryptBinMetadata — implementation diverged silently from the spec.

Pre-phase-65 round-trip tests left nodeRef/nodeReadKey undefined, so the real hex serialization path for nodeReadKey was never exercised; added a real un-mocked round-trip case with a 32-byte Uint8Array.
Still constructing SharedWriteContext with old folderKey/ipnsPrivateKey shape after 65-04 reshaped it — caught only by full pnpm typecheck, not by the worktree's targeted build.

deleteFromSharedFolder (public boundary) lacked childNodeId validation — a JS caller omitting it would remove the read-body item but leave the write-body stale, the same UUID/ipnsName mismatch class; added guard.

nodeRef in addToBin is built from primitives only (no Uint8Array fields), so the JSON.stringify serialization bug affected only nodeReadKey — no other Uint8Array or key material leaked into the bin blob.

rotateWriteSubtree processes children first (correct), but tombstones were fired inline per-node — added pendingTombstones collection so all tombstones fire only after the full subtree is published and parent re-pointed.

seedSharedFolder is reachable from live web navigation (useSharedNavigation.ts:199) — the Phase-68 placeholder bridge added optional writeKey?/publishedNode? fields that preserve status quo but will need real values wired in Phase 68.

workflow: Post-merge typecheck is the decisive cross-plan integration gate — worktree builds (pnpm tsc -p + targeted vitest) catch intra-plan issues but miss cross-consumer type breaks that only surface in the full chain.

Parallel worktree fix-agents should be clustered by package coupling (e.g. rotation domain / shared-write / primitives+bin) to minimize merge conflicts and avoid index.lock races when the main tree is also active.
Pre-commit hooks (husky) can be slow enough to trigger a 120s timeout on git commit — the commit still lands; verify with git log --oneline -1 before retrying, never blindly amend or retry.
The SCRATCH shell variable is not exported to subshell/node environments when passed via Bash; pass paths as inline arguments or via a file instead.

The live SDK E2E test-login secret is TEST_LOGIN_SECRET in apps/api/.env (e2e-test-secret-ci-only), not the SDK default (e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production) — auth 401s at startup indicate secret mismatch, not write-chain issues.

CodeRabbit re-reviews fix commits and raises new threads — plan for at least two fix rounds in ship-phase; the critical finding (tombstone ordering) was only surfaced in the PR review, not the CLI pass.

Greptile assigns a confidence score (3/5 here) specifically because mock-green tests don't exercise real serialization/crypto paths — its finding was the most valuable of the session; treat low confidence scores as a signal to add real integration tests at the layer where the contract lives.
The gh pr checks poll exits non-zero when any check fails or when the API blips; distinguish transient API errors from real failures by re-fetching once before escalating.
For worktree fix-agent waves, recording each agent's worktree into a manifest immediately on completion (not batched) avoids losing metadata if a later agent times out.

friction: 65-04 (shared-write) under-scoped its files_modified — reshaped SharedWriteContext but left context.ts, client.ts, SharedFolderState, and apps/web on the old shape, requiring a follow-up fix agent and adding a Phase-68 web bridge.
tail pipe in the post-merge typecheck command consumed the exit code, requiring a re-run with explicit exit-code capture.
SCRATCH shell variable not exported to subshell/node environments in two separate Bash commands, requiring inline path workarounds.
SDK E2E 401 on first live run due to SDK default secret not matching the API .env secret — required inspecting apps/api/.env to find TEST_LOGIN_SECRET.
Pre-commit hooks caused two git commit timeouts (exit 143); in both cases the commit had actually landed, requiring git log verification before any recovery action.
Background settle poll exited 1 due to a transient GitHub API blip on the final fetch, not a real CI failure — required a manual re-fetch to confirm green state.
gh pr edit rejected due to Projects-classic GraphQL on this repo — had to use gh api -X PATCH with a body file instead.
git push is blocked in the sandbox environment — required explicit sandbox-disabled flag for each push.

The bin nodeReadKey serialization bug was entirely invisible to all phase-65 testing (worktree builds, post-merge gate, sdk-core/sdk suites, live e2e) because bin.test.ts mocks both encrypt/decrypt helpers — only caught post-PR by greptile's static analysis.
open_items: Phase 68: wire real publishedNode and writeKey into SharedFolderState + client.ts buildSharedWriteContextFromState; implement resealAndPublishParent envelope return for SDK callers; remove PLACEHOLDER_PUBLISHED_NODE from apps/web (tracked: .planning/todos/pending/2026-06-30-phase68-shared-write-context-publishednode-wiring.md).

Phase 66: bin-delete pin-leak (442 MB leaked IPFS pins from deleted bin entries) — fix lives in apps/api/src/shares/*, re-tagged from Phase 65 (tracked: .planning/todos/pending/2026-06-23-bin-delete-and-empty-bin-leak-content-and-version-cid-pins.md).
Phase 66: WRITE-04 live publish-gate 403/410 on tombstoned IPNS names — currently a D-02 mock seam in Phase 65; Phase 66 owns the live cutover.

Test debt: write-chain e2e uses fixed-index key capture (capturedKeys[0/2]) for seed identification, which is brittle if ECIES wrapping emits extra 32-byte randoms (tracked: .planning/todos/pending/2026-06-30-write-chain-e2e-seed-index-stability.md).
client.ts subtree-IPNS-collect stub at lines 205/216 tagged 'phase 65' in error strings but not in any phase-65 plan's files_modified — out-of-scope carry-forward needing a future phase assignment.

Pre-existing sdk-e2e TypeScript errors in batch-upload, ipns-consistency, file-operations suites from the metadata refactor (FolderChild, FilePointer, SealedChildRef.id/.type removed) — tracked by existing todos but not assigned to a specific phase.

32-byte length validation missing from sealChildWriteKey/unsealChildWriteKey in seal.ts (role 0x04) — skipped because the role-0x02 twin also lacks it; adding only to 0x04 would diverge the verbatim pair; a future pass should add guards to both twins together.
